metadata.title: BADAL : An effort to preserve tribal Dance, Art and Literature | बादल: आदिवासी संस्कृति और साहित्य
metadata.description: Bastar Academy of Dance, Art and Language (BADAL) is established for the preservation and promotion of folk dance, local dialects, literature and craftsmanship of Bastar in Asna village near Jagdalpur, the headquarters of Bastar division.To transfer the different tribal cultures of Bastar from one generation to another through Badal Academy, to introduce them to the rest of the country and the world, to impart training in local dialect and language to the field staff-officers here for smooth performance of government works etc. work will be done.
